title: Archive through May 09, 2002 - Anonymous (prime.kapa.net - 206.135.162.167) (Tuesday, February 26, 2002 - 11:31 am)

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Seemed to lift out of the body; later described being in a pitch-black space with no ground, and in a later episode being lifted out of a chair and pulled quickly toward the dark place.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Chest/throat crushing and inability to breathe before separation; then absence of pain and 'getting lighter, lifting off the floor'.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Movement through black space toward a distant 'star'-like light; later, rapid pulling toward the dark place with a roaring sound; return path described as lit with black lines like road markings blending together as speed increased.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Accelerating toward the light; 'roaring sound' during later episode; 'floating through a thin vale' into white light.

arrival.other_being_detail: Later refers to the being as 'God' and also calls him an 'Angel' in dreams; describes a male presence who is the source of the white light.

environment.environment_other_detail: Pitch-black space with no ground/sides/corners; then a realm 'bathed in white light' characterized by overwhelming love/serenity; later a 'dark place' with 'millions of others' moving together like a single force.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told she could not stay because it was not her time; later given a choice to return with the condition she must never attempt self-destruction again and must accept her worth/responsibility and the power of choice.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: At age 12, swallowed father's high blood pressure medication in a suicide attempt; later NDE-like episode in early 30s during counseling (not a near-death medical crisis described, but counselor thought she 'sat there and died').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Second episode includes a distressing 'dark place' with many unseen souls moving together and a choice/lesson about suicide and consequences.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Initial episode: dying distress → separation/black void → movement toward distant light → entry into white light/being → told cannot stay → propelled back along a lit path with black lines → return to body/hospital. Later episode: sudden pull into dark place → observation/teaching about consequences → choice to return conditioned on not self-destructing → return to counselor's office.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Revisited the dark realm/light dynamic in early 30s; reports 'several experiences' and dreams of the angel/being.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived herself as intact but 'absent flesh'; return path showed black lines like road markings blending with speed; saw 'holes in the ground that we fill at death with our loved ones' and noted the graves were empty; later realm described as an in-between plane where 'millions of others' could not enter the light and suffered from full awareness of consequences.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "You can not stay here with me"; "It is not time for you to be here with me, but someday you will come back"; "It's time".
